name: moist_air_cooling_coil_contact_factor
title: Moist-air cooling coil with contact factor
summary: Moist air cooled over a coil of given mean surface temperature: contact factor applied to temperatures and humidity ratios, total/sensible/latent heat per kg of dry air and condensate mass.

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/humidair1.EES, EES 9.920)
verification.notes: 25/25 variables compared: algebraic relations exact; humidity ratios +0.46 to +0.51 % (CoolProp humid-air formulation with enhancement factor vs EES psychrometrics); moist-air enthalpies +0.3 %; derived energy results q 0.25 %, q_s 0.17 %, q_l 0.42 %. Dry-air absolute enthalpies differ by a reference-state offset (EES 0 K reference), their difference q_s agrees. No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/humidair1.eescode (same model, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
